name: NT apprentice workwear and workgear bonus
summary: First-year NT apprentices and trainees get money for workwear and equipment, with more for priority trade apprentices.
key: $300, or $1,000 for apprentices in a trade on the NT skilled occupation priority list, to buy workwear and equipment.
who: Full-time, part-time or school-based apprentice or trainee in first year
$1,000 needs a trade on the NT skilled occupation priority list
how: Paid after your training contract is lodged with your Apprentice Connect Australia provider; no separate application.
catches: The bonus is cancelled if correct bank details are not given within six months of being contacted.

source.label: NT Government: Get the bonus for workwear and gear

evidence.quote: you may be eligible to receive either $300 or $1,000 in funding to buy workwear and equipment.
be a full-time, part-time or school-based apprentice or trainee in your first year
